transfer.intake.title: Send · Intake
transfer.intake.lead: Every book enters here: upload, grab an article, computer-side shelf push, or scp into inbox. Goes into the master library as-is, bytes untouched — whether to clean it up and where to read it is decided later, in "Master library".
transfer.intake.usbHint: For big books, use USB https://10.11.99.1 — doesn't use Wi-Fi.
transfer.upload.title: Upload
transfer.upload.dropLabel: Click or drop books (multiple ok · {native} and the formats below)
transfer.fetchArticle.title: Grab an article
transfer.fetchArticle.hint: Works well on static pages; JS-heavy pages and paywalls can't be extracted. One article at a time (serials split by chapter are a later feature).
transfer.fetchArticle.fetching: Fetching…(extracting text over the network, a dozen seconds)
transfer.push.title: Computer-side shelf push (advanced cleanup / PDF reflow)
transfer.push.desc: Tricky books go through the computer: convert non-standard formats to EPUB, Calibre-grade deep cleaning, reflow PDF papers, convert comics to CBZ — everything the device itself can't do. The result also lands in this master library; pick its destination the same way in "Master library" below.
transfer.push.cmdIntro: The command looks like this (run it from this repo's directory; shelf/host/bin/shelf is the command — if that's too long, alias shelf="$PWD/shelf/host/bin/shelf"):
transfer.push.notes:
· Only followed by the books to push (multiple at once is fine); no output path, no target argument — the result always lands in the master library, you pick which reader it goes to in "Master library" below.
· Cleans with Calibre when it's installed (deep EPUB cleanup / convert odd formats to EPUB / structural PDF reflow, PDFs over 60MB auto-split); comics are auto-detected and converted to CBZ (override with --comic/--no-comic); --no-optimize skips cleanup and sends as-is; --to-pdf finalizes into a fixed-layout PDF for handwritten annotation.
· Same rule as the web UI: every book only lands in the master library — there's no option to push straight to a reader.
transfer.push.detailsSummary: Examples / why it's worth it / how to install
transfer.push.example.novel: convert to clean EPUB → master library (works in both readers)
transfer.push.example.comic: auto-detects comic → CBZ → master library (add to KOReader; comics don't go native)
transfer.push.example.toPdf: finalize as fixed-layout PDF → master library (for xochitl handwritten annotation)
transfer.push.strengths.dd: ① Convert odd formats to clean EPUB for native: AZW3 / MOBI / AZW / PRC / FB2 uploaded directly can only go to KOReader — this can convert them to EPUB for native; ② Calibre-grade deep cleaning: flattens CSS more thoroughly than the on-device pass, can rescue books with layout locks the device can't touch; ③ PDF paper reflow: multi-column / formulas / figures reflowed to screen width in reading order — the device can't do this (on-device PDFs only pass through as-is); ④ scans go through k2pdfopt. Output still gets the same on-device optimizer layered on top, so it looks the same as a direct web upload.
transfer.push.install.dd: Install Calibre (includes ebook-convert) + Python 3 on your computer → clone this repo → cd shelf && sh build.sh (builds epub-optimize) → then shelf/host/bin/shelf is ready to use.

transfer.opttable.full.what: Everything: strip font/size/color/alignment locks · zero out margins/paragraph spacing + first-line indent by CJK/Latin convention · auto-build a TOC from headings when missing · strip pseudo-DRM · inline footnotes in place, always shown · inline remote images · downsample images · boost e-ink contrast · dedupe duplicate ids
transfer.opttable.keepSpacing.what: Same as above, but leaves the original paragraph spacing alone
transfer.opttable.keepSpacing.when: Poetry, scripts, books that use blank lines to separate sections
transfer.opttable.plain.what: Only fixes footnotes / images / contrast / duplicate ids — layout and font locks are left untouched
transfer.opttable.plain.when: Already well-formatted books where you just want footnotes and images fixed
transfer.fmtTiers: {native}: works in both readers · {convertible}: computer-side shelf push can convert it to EPUB for native, a direct upload only reaches KOReader · {koOnly}: KOReader only · comics don't go native: AZW3/EPUB comics auto-convert to CBZ via computer-side shelf push, read them in KOReader
transfer.guide.summary: How does the master library work? Which reader should I pick? (click to expand)
transfer.guide.steps.dd: ① Intake: upload (book formats) / grab an article / computer-side shelf push / scp into inbox — the book goes into the master library as-is, bytes untouched. ② Optimize (optional): for EPUB, click "Optimize" to clean up layout, footnotes, CJK/Latin indentation (PDF isn't touched on-device — reflow needs the computer). ③ Deliver: click "Send to native library" or "Add to KOReader". The master copy stays put, so you can send it to the other reader any time. The reader pages (xochitl / KOReader) only manage their own fonts and dictionaries, not book transfer.
transfer.guide.native.dt: 📖 Send to native library (xochitl): books you'll annotate
transfer.guide.native.dd: TOC navigation, footnotes, font switching, direct handwritten annotation, AI interpretation. Put academic papers or anything you'll highlight here; finalized handwritten-annotation PDFs go here too.
transfer.guide.koreader.dt: 📚 Add to KOReader: casual reading, dictionary lookups
transfer.guide.koreader.dd: Free reflow, built-in dictionary, page-turn gestures. Good for novels, comics, foreign-language books.
transfer.guide.unsure.dd: Send it to one. The master copy stays, so you can send it to the other any time for comparison — don't overthink "casual vs. study", it's your call (some read detective novels for fun, others use them to map out clues; some just read comics, others study the art).
transfer.guide.push.dd: Tricky books go through the computer: convert non-standard formats to EPUB, deep-clean with Calibre, reflow PDF papers. The result also lands in this master library — pick its destination the same way here. See the command below on this page's "Intake" tab.

koreader.title: KOReader
koreader.installGuide.summary: How to install KOReader / what's already tuned for you
koreader.installGuide.install.dd: Installed from the official repo yourself: get the foundation (xovi + appload) in place first (see the "Manage" page), then install the reMarkable Paper Pro (rmpp) build from the official releases.
koreader.installGuide.tuned.dt: Already tuned for the Move screen (works out of the box, no manual setup)
koreader.installGuide.tuned.dd: This kit's profile matches xochitl's look and feel: Xiaolai Xin Zhi Song as the CJK font, page margins, line spacing, footnotes in a bottom popup, hanging punctuation, mis-touch prevention, exit gesture.
koreader.installGuide.books.dd: Bring the book into the master library on the "Send" page, then click "Add to KOReader" (every format the master library accepts can be read in KOReader). Whatever's there, you'll see it inside KOReader.
koreader.installGuide.restart.dt: After changing settings / deleting a font
koreader.installGuide.restart.dd: If KOReader is currently running, it needs a restart to pick up the change (the status above will say "running" as a hint).
